issue.description:
ADR-005 (Accepted 2026-08-16) specifies a `ready_frontier` check under doctor's `dependencies` scope warning when open issues carry an assignee (off the ready frontier with no active claim), naming a bounded sample of offending ids and the exact remedy `bead update <id> --clear-assignee`; advisory only, never cleared under --repair. The 2026-08-16 sweep found 583 such issues across 47 workspaces with ten starved frontiers while doctor reported healthy, and no open bead implements the check — the only related open items are a different defect (beadrs-90abfec2, blocked-count column bug) and a different feature (beadrs-892eb8ce, manual_blocked surfacing). Work needed: implement the check under the dependencies scope with tests for assigned-open detection, the bounded sample, the remedy text, and no-mutation-under---repair behavior.

issue.description:
ADR-004 requires a `cargo +1.85 check --all-targets` lane in the bead-rs-ci WorkflowTemplate, pinned to exactly the version Cargo.toml's rust-version declares, with lane/manifest drift being 'a CI failure, not a doc nit'. The ADR's own context records that the template installs --default-toolchain stable, so the declared floor is asserted rather than tested and any future dependency refresh can silently break 1.85. No open bead tracks this lane. Check the current bead-rs-ci template in declarative-config (k8s/iad-ci/argo-workflows) first: if the lane is absent, add it with the toolchain version read from rust-version; if present, add the missing drift guard. Per the deployment-bead policy, the manifest edit lands in declarative-config and this bead records the affected path, cluster/Application, and deployment commit.

Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Add the pinned MSRV verification lane and manifest-drift guard to bead-rs-ci (ADR-004)

issue.description:
ADR-004 requires a pinned MSRV lane (`cargo +1.85 check --all-targets`) in the `bead-rs-ci` Argo WorkflowTemplate so the declared Rust 1.85 floor is tested on every run instead of asserted, with drift between the lane's toolchain and the manifest's `rust-version` failing CI. No open bead tracks this lane, and the ADR records that the previous floor declaration was never exercised by any CI run. Add the lane to the template, derive or cross-check the pinned toolchain against the manifest's `rust-version`, verify the lane runs green on a pushed commit, and document it beside the existing fmt/clippy/test gates. Per the deployment-bead policy, record the affected declarative-config manifest path (k8s/iad-ci/argo-workflows bead-rs-ci template) and the ArgoCD sync on this bead.
